Schnittstelle Eval<A>

Typparameter:
A - the value type carried by this evaluation
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Appliable<Eval.µ,A>, Bindable<Eval.µ,A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<Eval.µ,A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Hkt<Eval.µ>, Mappable<Eval.µ,A>, Monadic<Eval.µ,A>, Supplier<A>, Transmogrifyable<Eval<A>>, Unwindable<Eval<A>>, Value<A>
Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
Eval.Always, Eval.Later, Eval.Now
public sealed interface Eval<A> extends Unwindable<Eval<A>>, Transmogrifyable<Eval<A>>, Monadic<Eval.µ,A>, Value<A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<Eval.µ,A> permits Eval.Now<A>, Eval.Later<A>, Eval.Always<A>

A monadic interface for deferred evaluation of values, similar in spirit to Cats’ Eval. It models three evaluation modes:

  • Now: eager, value is available immediately.
  • Later: lazy and memoized; computed on first access and cached thereafter.
  • Always: lazy and non‑memoized; computed on every access.

Contract: unless stated otherwise, inputs must not be null and results must not be null. Laziness is implemented via suppliers; unwinding and accessors may evaluate them.

Seit:
1.0.0

    • unwind

      @UnwindingOperation default @NonNull Eval<A> unwind()

      Unwinds this Eval to a semantically equivalent representation while preserving its concrete evaluation mode (subtype).

      • Now: returns a new Now with the current value.
      • Later: evaluates immediately and returns a Later that yields the materialized value (constant supplier; remains memoized and stable).
      • Always: preserves the original supplier to keep non‑memoized semantics.
      Angegeben von:
      unwind in Schnittstelle Unwindable<A>
      Gibt zurück:
      a semantically equivalent Eval with preserved subtype
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • now

      @UnwindingOperation default @NonNull Eval<A> now()

      Converts this Eval into an eager Eval.Now instance.

      If this is already a Now, it is returned as is. If this is a Later or Always, the value is computed immediately and wrapped in a new Now.

      Gibt zurück:
      an eager Now instance carrying the current value
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • later

      @UnwindingOperation default @NonNull Eval<A> later()

      Converts this Eval into a lazy, memoized Eval.Later instance.

      If this is already a Later, it is returned as is. Otherwise, a new Later is created that will compute (and cache) the value upon first access.

      Gibt zurück:
      a lazy, memoized Later instance
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • always

      @UnwindingOperation default @NonNull Eval<A> always()

      Converts this Eval into a lazy, non‑memoized Eval.Always instance.

      If this is already an Always, it is returned as is. If this is a Now or Later, it is converted into an Always that will re‑evaluate the underlying source or cached value (depending on implementation details) on every access.

      Gibt zurück:
      a lazy, non‑memoized Always instance
      Seit:
      1.0.0
